create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object with start and final nodes for pattern recognition
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn Graph with optional start and final flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label
draw_gtn_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with arc and node symbol mappings
union_gtn_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph objects into a single combined graph
